name: Leapmotor
verdict: Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (09863); the single largest shareholder group is founder Zhu Jiangming acting in concert with Fu Liquan and their spouses (23.75%), with Stellantis N.V. at 19.99% and a Hangzhou state-backed pre-IPO fund at 0.85%. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor ('零跑汽车 LEAPMOTOR') of Zhejiang FC for the 2026 Chinese Super League season, continuing as the club's main sponsor since 2024 (Leapmotor/club announcement of 8 March 2026; Tencent News survey of 2026 CSL chest sponsors).
